title: Dashboard loads KPI cards, charts, and recent activities for an authenticated user
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can open the Dashboard and see key KPI cards, trend charts, and recent activity content rendered.

title: Dashboard shows mail and archive statistics cards
description: Verifies that Dashboard statistic cards for incoming/outgoing mail and archives are visible after login.

title: Dashboard renders mail trend charts
description: Verifies that the mail trend visualization area is visible on the Dashboard for an authenticated user.

title: Dashboard shows recent activities list
description: Verifies that the recent activities section is visible and appears populated on the Dashboard.

steps.description: Scroll to the recent activities section
Verify element "Recent activities list" is visible

title: Filter Dashboard by Unit Kerja updates visible KPI/charts context
description: Verifies that selecting a Unit Kerja filter updates the Dashboard context and refreshed content is shown.

steps.description: Click on the "Unit Kerja" filter control
Select the first available Unit Kerja option from the dropdown
Verify the selected Unit Kerja name is visible in the filter control

title: Filter Dashboard by Unit Kerja and verify charts section remains visible after update
description: Verifies that after changing Unit Kerja, the charts section remains visible (indicating re-render) and no error message is shown.

steps.description: Click on the "Unit Kerja" filter control
Select the second available Unit Kerja option from the dropdown

title: Dashboard shows loading skeletons before content appears
description: Verifies that loading placeholders are shown initially and then the Dashboard content becomes visible.

steps.description: Wait for the dashboard content to appear

title: Search and filter incoming mail list
description: Verifies that a user can search and apply filters on the incoming mail list and see the list update accordingly.

steps.description: Type a keyword from a visible mail row (for example, part of a subject/sender/nomor) into the search field
Verify at least one mail row is visible
Select a date range using the date filter controls
Verify the list updates and mail rows are still visible or a visible "no results" message is shown
Select a value from the status filter dropdown
Verify the list updates and matches the chosen filter or a visible "no results" message is shown

title: Create a new incoming mail (without attachment)
description: Verifies that a user can create a new incoming mail and see it appear in the incoming mail list.

steps.description: Fill a valid "Nomor Surat" value into the "Nomor Surat" field
Fill a valid value into the "Tanggal Surat" (or equivalent date) field
Fill a valid value into the "Pengirim" (sender) field
Fill a valid value into the "Perihal" (subject) field

title: Create a new incoming mail (attempt attachment upload if supported)
description: Verifies that the attachment section is present on the create form and that the user can proceed with submission when attachments are optional.

steps.description: Fill a valid "Nomor Surat" value into the "Nomor Surat" field
Fill a valid value into the "Perihal" (subject) field
Verify element "Incoming mail list/table" is visible

title: View incoming mail details from list
description: Verifies that a user can open an incoming mail detail view and see key detail information.

steps.description: Click on the first visible incoming mail row (or its "Detail" action)
Verify text "Detail Surat Masuk" or "Surat Masuk" is visible

title: Edit an existing incoming mail and verify updated values
description: Verifies that a user can edit an incoming mail and see the updated values on the detail page.

steps.description: Click the "Edit" action for the first visible mail item
Fill a new unique value into the "Perihal" (subject) field
Verify the updated subject text is visible in the detail view

title: Create incoming mail validation: missing required nomor surat
description: Verifies that the form blocks submission and shows a validation error when required field Nomor Surat is missing.

steps.description: Fill a valid value into the "Perihal" (subject) field

title: Delete an incoming mail from list (confirm deletion)
description: Verifies that a user can delete an incoming mail after confirming the deletion dialog and the list reflects the deletion.

steps.description: Type a keyword from the first visible mail row into the search field
Verify at least one mail row is visible
Click the "Delete" action for the first visible mail item
Verify text "Konfirmasi" or "Are you sure" is visible
Click the "Hapus" or "Confirm" button in the confirmation dialog
Verify the list updates and either the row is no longer visible or a visible success message is shown

title: Delete an incoming mail but cancel in confirmation dialog
description: Verifies that canceling the delete confirmation leaves the incoming mail item in the list.

steps.description: Type a keyword from the first visible mail row into the search field
Verify at least one mail row is visible
Click the "Delete" action for the first visible mail item
Verify text "Konfirmasi" or "Are you sure" is visible
Click the "Batal" or "Cancel" button in the confirmation dialog
Verify at least one mail row is still visible

title: Search and filter outgoing mail from the outgoing mail list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open the outgoing mail list, use search/filter controls, and see the results update on screen.

title: Create a new outgoing mail (without attachments) and confirm it appears in the list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a new outgoing mail using the add flow and see it listed afterward.

title: View outgoing mail details from the list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open an outgoing mail detail page and see the detail view content.

steps.description: Click on the first outgoing mail row in the list

title: Edit an existing outgoing mail and verify updated value is shown in details
description: Verifies an authenticated user can edit an outgoing mail and see updated metadata on the detail view.

steps.description: Click the "Edit" button for the first outgoing mail in the list

title: Validate create outgoing mail form rejects invalid date format
description: Verifies the create outgoing mail form shows a visible validation error and remains on the create page when an invalid date format is submitted.

title: Delete an outgoing mail from the list and confirm it is removed
description: Verifies an authenticated user can delete an outgoing mail via confirmation and sees it removed from the visible list (or an error message if deletion fails).

steps.description: Click the "Delete" button for the first outgoing mail in the list

title: Search yields no results message on outgoing mail list
description: Verifies the outgoing mail list provides a visible empty-state when the search query matches no mails.

title: Cancel deletion from confirmation dialog keeps the mail in the list
description: Verifies that choosing cancel/close on the deletion confirmation does not remove the outgoing mail from the list.

steps.description: Click the "Delete" button for the first outgoing mail in the list
Verify element "Outgoing mail list" is visible

title: Switch between Masuk/Keluar tabs and verify list & pagination are visible
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open the archive page, switch tabs, and see the list and pagination controls.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation

title: Search archives and verify matching rows appear
description: Verifies searching within the archive list returns matching results in the visible table/list.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation

title: Open an archive detail from the list and verify metadata & storage info are shown
description: Verifies a user can navigate from the archive list to an archive detail page and see key information sections.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation
Click the first archive row in the list

title: Filter archives approaching retention deadline and select items for batch review
description: Verifies retention-related filtering can be applied and that selecting items updates the selected count.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation
Select "Mendekati Retensi" from the retention status dropdown
Click the checkbox for the first archive row

title: Search with no matching results shows 'No results' message
description: Verifies the archive list handles empty search results by displaying an explicit no-results state.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation

title: Pagination changes the visible page of archives
description: Verifies pagination controls allow navigating to another page of archives and the page indicator updates.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation

title: Open a non-existent archive detail via in-app ID entry and see 'not found' handling
description: Verifies the UI shows an 'Archive not found' message or returns to the archive list when a non-existent ID is requested from within the app.

steps.description: Click the "Arsip" menu item in the main navigation
Click the "Cari berdasarkan ID" (Search by ID) control
Verify text "Archive not found" is visible

title: Super admin can view the user list and search for an existing user
description: Verifies that a super admin can open User Management, search, and see a matching user row in the list.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Type a known user name or email into the user search field
Verify a user row matching the search text is visible

title: Super admin can create a new user and see it appear in the list
description: Verifies that a super admin can create a user via the Create New User flow and then find the created user in the user list.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Fill the Name field with "E2E User SuperAdmin"
Select an available option from the Unit Kerja dropdown

title: Super admin can edit an existing user role and see the update reflected in the list
description: Verifies that a super admin can edit a user, change role, save, and observe the updated role in the user list.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Type a known user name or email into the user search field
Verify at least one user row is visible
Click the "Edit" action for the first visible user row
Select a different option from the Role dropdown
Verify the updated role label is visible in the edited user row

title: Super admin can edit an existing user unit kerja and see the update reflected
description: Verifies that a super admin can update a user's unit assignment and see the new unit value displayed.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Type a known user name or email into the user search field
Verify at least one user row is visible
Click the "Edit" action for the first visible user row
Select a different option from the Unit Kerja dropdown
Verify the updated Unit Kerja value is visible in the edited user row

title: Non-super admin is blocked from User Management
description: Verifies that a non-super-admin user cannot access the Users page and sees an access denied state or is redirected away.

title: Authenticated non-super admin is denied access to /users via navigation
description: Verifies that a logged-in non-super-admin user cannot open User Management from the UI and sees access denied or gets redirected to dashboard.

steps.description: Click the user profile menu in the header
Click "Users" in the main navigation menu

title: Super admin can deactivate a user and see deactivated status
description: Verifies that a super admin can deactivate a user, confirm the action, and see the user marked as deactivated in the list.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Type a known active user name or email into the user search field
Verify a user row matching the search text is visible
Click the "Deactivate" action for the matching user row
Click the "Confirm" button in the confirmation dialog
Verify text "Deactivated" is visible in the user row

title: User search shows no results state when query does not match
description: Verifies that searching with a non-existent query displays an empty state or no matching rows.

steps.description: Click "Users" in the main navigation menu
Type "no-such-user-xyz-12345" into the user search field

title: Generate a report with valid filters and view results
description: Verifies an authenticated user can generate a report with a selected type and valid date range and see results displayed.

steps.description: Select a report type from the report type dropdown
Set a valid start date in the start date filter
Set a valid end date (after the start date) in the end date filter
Verify text "Report" is visible on the results area

title: Generate report without changing defaults (smoke)
description: Verifies an authenticated user can generate a report using default selections and see results.

title: Invalid date range shows validation and stays on Reports page
description: Verifies the UI blocks generating a report when end date is before start date and shows a validation message.

steps.description: Set the start date filter to a later date
Set the end date filter to an earlier date than the start date
Verify text "End date must be after start date" is visible

title: Loading indicator appears while generating a report
description: Verifies a visible loading state is shown after clicking Generate and before results appear.

title: Changing report type changes the generated output context
description: Verifies selecting a different report type impacts the displayed report results (by visible report title/header).

steps.description: Select a specific report type (Type A) from the report type dropdown
Verify text "Type A" is visible in the report header
Select a different report type (Type B) from the report type dropdown
Verify text "Type B" is visible in the report header
